milestone: Milestone v3.6 Step 2A Phase 5B: Validation Adjudication Summary

qualitative_disagreements.annotator_A_rationale: Explains a procedural inference rule and variable dependency (Skolem function). While it explains why reordering fails algebraically, it presents no universe of discourse, domain elements, or truth valuations under a model. Under v1.1.0, this is an intermediate procedural explanation capped at Level 3.
qualitative_disagreements.annotator_B_rationale: Discusses syntactic rule of inference and formal proof constraint (Skolem functions). It operates purely at the level of deduction rules and syntax manipulation, without defining truth under an interpretation or model. Rated Level 2 TERMINOLOGY_DEFINITIONS_SYNTAX.

1C.adjudication_rationale: Annotator A noted Skolem variable dependency as procedural rule (Level 3); Annotator B noted pure non-commutativity syntax (Level 2). Consensus: Skolem dependency without semantic domain models is capped at Level 2/3 and unequivocally falls short of Level 4 truth conditions.

1D.adjudication_rationale: Full concordance: Concrete domain model over real numbers evaluating additive inverses satisfies Level 4 Semantic Models.

2C.adjudication_rationale: Full concordance: Formal mass-balance excretion equation CL_R = U*V/P is an algebraic identity capped at Level 4; does not provide cellular transport biology.

2D.adjudication_rationale: Full concordance: Podocyte filtration, active OAT/OCT carrier secretion, and pH-dependent reabsorption satisfy Level 5 Causal Biological Mechanism.

3C.adjudication_rationale: Full concordance: Bedside mental arithmetic (15 mg/kg * 70 kg = 1050 -> 1000 mg) and verbal rate constraint are informal estimation; falls short of Level 6 multi-step execution trace.

3D.adjudication_rationale: Full concordance: 7-step quantitative calculation trace with chained states, commercial rounding, and therapeutic window verification satisfies Level 6 Worked Application.

4C.adjudication_rationale: Full concordance: Itemized FIR specification parameter roster (M, omega_p, omega_s, delta_p, A_s) without hardware primitives is Level 2 Parameter Specification Roster.

4D.adjudication_rationale: Full concordance: Direct Form I structural primitives (tapped delay line z^-1, multipliers b_k, adder accumulation tree) satisfy Level 5 Architectural Constituent Primitives without requiring dynamic signal simulation.
